## Duke Symphony Orchestra concert

Come on!

- Tchaikovsky - Serenade for Strings in C major, Op. 48 (1880-81)
- Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 9 in E♭ major, K. 271 (1777);
- Sibelius - Symphony No. 3 in C major, Op. 52 (1907).

Get in there!

- Wednesday December 2 at 7:30 pm;
- Baldwin Auditorium;
- [@dukesymphony](https://www.instagram.com/dukesymphony/?hl=en).
